acceptance: No token or key values remain in zsh history, the local atuin database or atuin sync
A filter prevents the same token formats from being recorded again
description: `~/.zsh_history` and the atuin database on the maintainer's Mac contain plaintext tokens and keys (Databricks, OpenAI, Cerebras, Gemini, Meta, Claude Code and a todo-db token), typed or echoed on the command line. atuin last synced on 2026-07-27, so its sync server may hold copies. Rotate the credentials first (rotate-credentials-emudhra-exposure-20261023), then delete the entries locally and from atuin sync, and prevent recurrence (atuin `history_filter`, zsh `HIST_IGNORE_SPACE` or `zshaddhistory`, reading secrets from the keychain instead of command arguments). Rewriting history needs the owner's approval.
